resolution_summary: 2026-09-17 Human/Ops 裁決：PROD-GCP-01~05 五項全部結清，解除本 task 的 blocked recovery disposition。原 blocker（2026-09-14）稱五項均為 pending_human_decision，經本日逐項實測，其中四項早已完成，僅第五項需要新裁示，現已一併定案。

human_authority_checklist.requirement: Dedicated production GCP Project ID (or formal signoff on shared project partitioning), region selection (e.g. asia-east1), and resource naming conventions.
human_authority_checklist.resolution_evidence: production 專用專案 odayplus-prod-20260826（project_number 365886461656）lifecycle_state=ACTIVE，region asia-east1；GitHub production environment 的 GCP_PROJECT_ID／GCP_REGION／GCP_AR_REPO 均已設定。與 dev/staging 共用的 odayplus-runtime-20260825 為不同專案，production 早已分離，無須再做共用專案分割簽署。

human_authority_checklist.requirement: Production Workload Identity Pool provider attribute mapping to repository alfloop-dev/odayplus, production deployer SA with least-privilege Cloud Run & Secret Manager bindings, and runtime/scheduler service accounts.

Production Cloud SQL PostgreSQL 16 instance with private IP / Cloud SQL Auth proxy, dedicated Secret Manager secrets (ODAY_DATABASE_URL_SECRET, ODP_AUTH_PRINCIPAL_MAP_SECRET, ODP_WEB_SESSION_SECRET_SECRET, ODP_WEB_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET_SECRET).
Google Auth Platform Web application OAuth 2.0 Client ID & Secret configured with production authorized redirect URIs and custom serving domains (ODP_PROD_DEPLOY_URL, ODP_PROD_API_URL).
human_authority_checklist.resolution_evidence: ODP_PROD_API_URL 與 ODP_PROD_DEPLOY_URL 均已設定。OAuth client 部分依 2026-09-13 的 D15 決策失效：定案採帳密登入、Google OIDC 不啟用，實測 production 與 staging 的 ODP_AUTH_MODE 皆為 local，HUMAN-GCP-WEB-OAUTH-CLIENTS-001 已標 non_dispatchable=true。故本項不再包含建立 Web OAuth client 的要求。

human_authority_checklist.requirement: Production watch window duration, SLO and rollback latency/error thresholds, and designated rollback/on-call owner assignment.
human_authority_checklist.resolution_evidence: watch 窗口：切換後 60 分鐘密集觀察（人在線上），接續 24 小時自動監控。Rollback 觸發閾值：錯誤率 > 1%，或 p95 延遲 > 2 秒。Rollback 完成目標：15 分鐘內。指定 rollback／on-call 負責人：蔡尚志（與 H07 簽核人一致，避免決策者與 rollback 執行者分屬不同人）。裁定理由：此為 production 首次部署且系統從未實際承載流量，窗口需長到能採集真實流量峰谷，閾值需敏感到能在使用者回報前發現。

production_infrastructure_readback_summa.vpc_connector_omitted_reason: infra/terraform cloud_run.tf uses Direct VPC egress (network_interfaces + ALL_TRAFFIC); VPC_BINDING_MODES mutually exclusive; ODP_CLOUD_RUN_VPC_CONNECTOR intentionally omitted
